sacraments.text: Infant baptism on second Sundays bi-monthly at 11:30 in Main Church; remaining published 2026 date is 8 November, with compulsory in-person preparation for parents/godparents 31 October at 14:00 in St Faustina Room (L4), application deadline 25 October. Attach child’s birth certificate and marriage certificate; submit at least two weeks ahead. No separate/Zoom preparation.
sacraments.contact: Francis Ang 9685 2537 (SMS or call after 18:00); infantbaptism@divinemercy.sg; parish office 6583 3378

sacraments.text: Register at least one year ahead. Submit updated baptismal extract, civil marriage certificate if applicable, and MPC/EE certificate. Check church/chapel availability with Secretariat, complete application and email it. Complete MPC or EE; fill pre-nuptial form with priest at least one month before wedding. Marriage Partners help with liturgy.
Contact Parish Office to arrange a priest’s visit.

Submit death and baptism certificates to Secretariat and provide wake duration and desired funeral date. Secretariat arranges priest/venue, Lazarus Ministry wake prayers and a funeral minister to assist with readings and prayers.
Adult confirmation announced for 15 November at 17:30. Compulsory sessions: 12, 19, 26 October at 20:00 and 6 November at 19:30. Register with Parish Office. Announcement does not print year.
Call Parish Office as soon as possible in case of serious illness or hospitalisation; the page also suggests contacting the parish nearest the hospital.
Download the request form and submit to Parish Office. Communion ministers visit homes over the weekend.

Published journey started 25 July 2026; weekly Saturday sessions at 15:00. Welcomes inquirers and baptised Christians from other denominations. Inquirers can explore without obligation. Active parishioners can apply to be sponsors.
